SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT

This Service Level Agreement applies to the hosted platform that Northgate Systems LLC ("Provider") makes available to Pell Mercantile, Inc. ("Customer") under the parties' Subscription Agreement.

1. Availability. Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to keep the platform available to Customer at all times.

2. Maintenance. Provider may take the platform offline for maintenance when it considers it necessary.

3. Support. Provider's support desk is open from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Eastern time on business days. Provider will acknowledge each support request within one business day.

4. Reporting. On Customer's request, Provider will give Customer a report of platform availability for the preceding month.
